title: A Child Called "It": One Child's Courage to Survive
author: Dave Pelzer
current_text: A Child Called "It" was removed from Sussex, Del. Central Middle School in 2000 pending a committee review because of its profanity and violence.

sources.quote: Pelzer, Dave. A Child Called It. Health Communications; Omaha Pr. Pub. Co. Removed from the Sussex, Del. Central Middle School (2000) until the committee completes its review because of the book’s profanity and violence. Source: July 2000, p. 105.
